branches.store: chart-chains, chart-heat, chart-box, chart-city-chains, chart-isolated, map-main, kpi:chains, insight:leader, insight:regional, insight:single — chain; sub-brand variants folded into the shorter root name
branches.branch: map-main — branch name shown in the map popup; 488 distinct free-text names, 50 empty, no aggregate view
branches.city: chart-cities, chart-city-size, chart-city-chains, chart-heat, chart-bands, kpi:cities, kpi:single_city, insight:cities, insight:single — yod-doubling spelling variants merged
branches.address: map-main, insight:dupes — popup line; also used to detect repeated (chain, address) rows
branches.X: map-main, chart-nn, chart-isolated, kpi:median_nn, kpi:far, insight:isolated, insight:dense — ITM easting
branches.Y: map-main, chart-bands, chart-box, chart-nn, chart-isolated, insight:regional — ITM northing; latitude approximated linearly for the north–south views
branches.report_date: kpi:branches — the list's as-of date (single value per snapshot)
branches.PRIVATE_COMPANY: skip: operating company registration number — an identifier; chains are grouped by name, and the same chain appears under several company numbers (incl. a 555555555 placeholder)
branches.SETTL_CODE: skip: CBS settlement code; the city name is used instead (one code covers two different towns in this file)
branches.N_HOME: skip: house number — part of the address
branches.ADDRESS_CONC: skip: street + number, duplicated in address
branches.street: skip: street name, duplicated in address
